results.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
results.snippet: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferen…

results.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
results.snippet: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark…

results.title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
results.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by leveraging pre-trained vision-language backbones. However, in downstream robotic settings, they are typically fine-tuned with limited data, leading to overfitting to specific instruction formulations and leaving robustness to paraphrased instructions underexplored. To study this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Para, a controlled benchmark that independently varies action expressions and object references for fine-grained analysis of linguistic generalization. results.title: LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models
results.snippet: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. results.title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
results.snippet: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment control through flow-matching mid-training, and adapts the policy through real-world post-training. We introduce Rollback, which pairs replaced poli…

results.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
results.snippet: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Cru…

results.title: Grounded-Dreamer: Robot Learning from World Model Synthetic Data with Physical Grounding
results.snippet: Scaling robot manipulation policies requires large amounts of diverse, action-labeled data, yet collecting such data in the real world remains expensive and difficult to scale. Existing methods either depend on human teleoperation, rely on simulation with limited visual realism, or use human videos that lack embodiment-specific annotations. In this paper, we introduce Grounded-Dreamer, a framework for synthesizing physically grounded robot manipulation data with video world models while avoiding human teleoperation demonstrations. Grounded-Dreamer combines the visual realism of generative vid…

The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

findings.point: 大规模真机轨迹数据已成为 VLA 基础模型的核心竞争力，头部厂商已突破 10 万小时量级
findings.evidence: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 使用超过 100K 小时真实世界轨迹训练，实现开箱即用的移动操作泛化；Meituan-Robotics-0 使用 15,060 小时精选轨迹覆盖 12 种本体
findings.attention: 高 | 两篇 2026 年中后期 arXiv 论文分别来自小米、美团机器人团队，代表产业界最新数据规模纪录
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ | 直接展示当前 VLA 数据规模天花板，是理解数据效率瓶颈与规模化路线的关键一手资料

findings.point: 多本体/多任务统一训练已成主流范式，MR0 在 12 种本体上联合训练
findings.evidence: Meituan-Robotics-0 明确指出跨越 12 种本体的 15,060 小时轨迹联合训练，采用三阶段训练配方对齐多模态表征与机器人行为
findings.attention: 高 | 12 本体联合训练是当前公开文献中本体覆盖最广的工作之一
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ | 为跨本体泛化与统一动作空间提供实证基准

findings.point: 世界模型生成合成数据并结合物理 grounding 成为缓解数据稀缺的新路径
findings.evidence: Grounded-Dreamer 提出从世界模型生成合成数据并进行物理 grounding，旨在解决真机采集昂贵、仿真视觉真实度不足、人类视频缺乏本体标注三大痛点
findings.attention: 高 | 直接切中数据效率与 Sim2Real 核心瓶颈，属于 2026 年下半年最新范式
findings.recommendation: ★★★★★ | 兼顾数据效率与 Sim2Real，是当前最值得跟踪的蓝海方向之一

findings.point: Sim2Real 瓶颈正从“域随机化”转向“世界模型合成+物理 grounding”
findings.evidence: Grounded-Dreamer 明确指出现有方法要么依赖人类遥操作、要么依赖视觉真实度有限的仿真、要么使用缺乏本体标注的人类视频，提出世界模型合成数据+物理 grounding 作为新解法
findings.attention: 中 | 单篇论文提出的新范式，尚待社区复现与基准验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ | 标志了 Sim2Real 研究从工程调参转向生成式世界模型的潜在拐点

findings.point: 长时程推理与复杂移动操作仍依赖海量真机数据堆砌，缺乏显式推理机制
findings.evidence: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 通过 100K+ 小时真机数据实现“开箱即用的移动操作”，但论文未披露显式长时程规划/推理模块，主要靠规模化模仿学习获得涌现能力
findings.attention: 中 | 反映当前 SOTA 仍以数据驱动涌现为主，显式推理仍是开放问题
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆ | 提示长时程推理可能需要架构层面创新而非单纯堆数据

findings.point: 基础模型透明度指数（FMTI）开始覆盖机器人基础模型，但 2025 版尚未包含 VLA 专用指标
findings.evidence: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index 为第三版年度报告，新增数据获取等指标，但快照中未见针对 VLA/机器人模型的专门评测维度
findings.attention: 低 | 关注点在通用基础模型透明度，机器人/VLA 维度尚缺
findings.recommendation: ★★☆☆☆ | 仅作为背景参考，提示 VLA 社区缺乏标准化透明度/可复现性基准

report_md:
# 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿进展、生态演变与未来信号增量快照

**日期**：2026-11-12（UTC）  
**领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA（Vision-Language-Action）  
**检索源数量**：32 条可核查来源（arXiv 预印本、官方技术报告、基准榜单、开源项目）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 核心增量判断
**近 1-2 年（2025Q3–2026Q4）的核心增量是：真机轨迹数据规模从“万小时级”跃升至“十万小时级”，多本体联合训练覆盖达 12 种本体，世界模型合成数据+物理 grounding 成为缓解 Sim2Real 与数据稀缺的新范式，LIBERO 系列基准将评测维度细化至个性化、工业约束、指令鲁棒性与闭环视觉鲁棒性四大维度。** [1][2][3][14][15][16][17]

## 3. 蓝海与缺口

### 3.1 核心增量判断
**当前蓝海集中在：(1) 世界模型合成数据的物理一致性保证与最小 grounding 监督；(2) 显式长时程推理/规划机制在 VLA 中的架构集成（离散技能层、世界模型规划、思维链）；(3) 跨本体动作空间的理论最优统一表示；(4) 面向真机多任务、多本体、长时程、OOD 泛化的标准化评测基准与透明度指标。** [1][2][3][14][15][16][17][20]

### 4.1 核心增量判断
**Sim2Real 瓶颈正从“域随机化/系统辨识”转向“世界模型合成+物理 grounding”新范式；长时程推理仍依赖海量数据涌现而非显式机制；数据规模定律的边际收益递减拐点临近，亟需算法层面突破；评测基准碎片化阻碍横向对比与复现。** [1][2][3][11][12][14][15][16][17]
